headerDisplay: Ecoforest ecoGEO heat pump through the local easyNet web interface.

host.title: easyNet URL
host.description: Base URL of the heat pump web interface (http:// or https://).

username.title: Username
username.description: Heat pump serial number (same as the easyNet web login).

password.title: Password
password.description: First 8 characters of the original Wi-Fi password (same as the easyNet web login).

heatingCoolingGroupCount.title: Number of heating/cooling circuits (G1..Gn)
heatingCoolingGroupCount.description: Creates a "Gn Consumption Demand" contact sensor (closed / Yes while the group has demand; open / No otherwise) and a "Gn Setpoint Temperature" sensor for each group.

powerSwitchMode.title: Power switch behaviour
powerSwitchMode.description: HomeKit cannot ask for confirmation, so switching the whole heat pump off can require a second tap.
